usedFor: Livestorm holds webinar registrants, Facebook Pages holds your posts and comments, and “Registrant Attended” can start “Send a Private Reply”.

bestTemplate.name: “Registrant Attended” in Livestorm, then “Send a Private Reply” in Facebook Pages
bestTemplate.why: A registrant who attended gets a private reply to a post or comment on your Page.

watchOut: “Send a Private Reply” reaches someone outside the business, so it waits for your approval before going out.
